item.title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,750 over past day
item.description: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to October 4, 2026, have reached approximately 1,540,700 personnel, including 1,750 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

item.title: Russian forces shell 47 settlements in Zaporizhzhia region over past day
item.description: Over the past 24 hours, Russian forces launched 745 attacks on 47 settlements in the Zaporizhzhia region. Two people were injured in enemy shelling of the Zaporizhzhia district.

item.title: Izium hit by large-caliber multiple rocket launchers
item.description: Russian forces struck the city of Izium in the Kharkiv region with large-caliber multiple rocket launchers, sparking a fire and damaging houses.

item.title: Russia has reduced use of ballistic missiles ahead of winter – Dutch analyst
item.description: Dutch analyst Patrick Bolder believes that Russia is currently using fewer ballistic missiles in its attacks on Ukraine and is carrying out a significant proportion of its strikes with jet-powered drones, apparently saving ballistic missiles for further use during the winter.

item.title: Dutch writer: I was trying to show Netherlands what Ukraine is like just as war began
item.description: Dutch writer of Ukrainian descent Lisa Weeda called it an "absolutely crazy situation" that she had to show people Ukraine, one of Europe's largest countries, at precisely the time when a war was raging there.

item.title: More than 3,800 marriages registered in Ukraine last week – Justice Ministry
item.description: More than 3,800 marriages were registered in Ukraine last week, with the highest number of marriages recorded in Kyiv.

item.title: Fragments from drone debris cause fire at non-residential building in Kyiv
item.description: A fire broke out at a non-residential building in Kyiv's Desnianskyi district as a result of falling drone debris.

item.title: First underground preschool opens in Zaporizhzhia
item.description: The first underground preschool has opened in Zaporizhzhia.

item.title: Pivnenko: Russian forces outnumber Ukrainian Defense Forces six to one in some areas of Donetsk region
item.description: Commander of the Ukrainian National Guard Oleksandr Pivnenko visited National Guard units carrying out combat missions in the Kharkiv and Donetsk regions and heard reports from their commanders.

item.title: Working body to be set up under NSDC to identify bodies of fallen defenders
item.description: A working body on the identification of the bodies of fallen Ukrainian defenders will be established under the National Security and Defense Council of Ukraine.

item.title: Zelensky awards Hero of Ukraine title to Sergeant Oleksii Kapeliushnyi
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has awarded the title of Hero of Ukraine, along with the Order of the Gold Star, to Sergeant Oleksii Kapeliushnyi.

item.title: Twelve state-owned coal mining enterprises to be transferred to State Property Fund
item.description: The Cabinet of Ministers has adopted a decision to transfer 12 integral property complexes of state-owned enterprises from the management of the Ministry of Energy to the State Property Fund of Ukraine.

item.title: We will waste time if we play around with Russian compromises – Zelensky
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said he believes the allies will only waste time if they play around with Russian compromises.

item.title: Wave of hybrid attacks in Europe is attempt to intimidate population – Zelensky
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said the recent wave of Russian hybrid attacks in Europe is an attempt to intimidate the European population.

item.title: Ukraine to cover current financial deficit by end of year – president
item.description: Ukraine plans to cover its current financial deficit by the end of 2026.

item.title: Zelensky: Ukrainian forces have liberated 125-140 sq km in Operation Vivaldi
item.description: Ukrainian forces have liberated 125-140 square kilometers of territory during Operation Vivaldi.

item.title: Woman killed as Russian drone strikes car in Kharkiv region
item.description: A woman was killed and a man was injured after a Russian drone struck a civilian car in the village of Shestakove, Kharkiv region.

item.title: Russian forces attack Odesa, infrastructure damaged
item.description: Russian forces attacked Odesa on Saturday, damaging infrastructure.

item.title: Ukraine to step up strikes on Russian oil refineries in response to Putin's 'new doctrine' – Zelensky
item.description: Ukraine will step up strikes on Russian oil refineries in response to Russia's new tactics of launching massive attacks on civilian infrastructure.

item.title: Three injured as Russian forces shell Dnipropetrovsk region more than 40 times
item.description: Russian forces attacked three districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region more than 40 times with various types of weapons on October 3, injuring three civilians.

item.title: Kyiv to start building pontoon bridges over Dnipro – Kalashnyk
item.description: Kyiv plans to begin construction of several backup crossings over the Dnipro River next week that could be used if bridges are damaged. In the longer term, authorities are also considering building a tunnel under the river.

item.title: Zelensky: Ukraine's sanctions now reach Samara region and Iskander launch sites in Bryansk region
item.description: Ukrainian sanctions today reached the Samara region and the positions of Russian invaders manning Iskander launchers in the Bryansk region of the Russian Federation.

item.title: Drone debris falls onto roof of high-rise building in Kyiv's Obolon district
item.description: In Kyiv’s Obolon district, debris from a drone fell onto the roof of a high-rise building, causing a fire.

item.title: Drone crashes onto roadway in Haivoron, killing one person and injuring another
item.description: In the city of Haivoron, Kirovohrad region, a man was killed and a woman was injured when a Russian drone crashed onto the roadway.

item.title: Writer: Netherlands still struggles to shake off narrative of Russia as Ukraine's “big brother”
item.description: Lisa Weeda, a Dutch writer of Ukrainian descent, stated that in the Netherlands it is still difficult to shake off the narrative of Russia as Ukraine’s “big brother.”

item.title: Russian guided bomb strikes hit businesses in Sumy region
item.description: Russian troops attacked civilian enterprises in the Kovpakivsky District of Sumy with four guided bombs; hits were recorded at two locations.

item.title: Lubinets shows dozens of people trying to leave Oleshky
item.description: Dmytro Lubinets, the Verkhovna Rada Commissioner for Human Rights, posted a video showing dozens of people in Oleshky, Kherson region—which is currently occupied by Russian forces—trying to leave the city on their own.

item.title: Putin claims Russia seized 1,301 square kilometers of Ukrainian territory in September, sharply diverging from ISW data
item.description: Kremlin dictator Vladimir Putin claimed that in September, Russian troops seized more than 1,300 km² of Ukrainian territory; however, these claims differ significantly from the actual data on the situation at the front.

item.title: Russian forces attack civilian vessel in Odesa region port, killing one and injuring three others
item.description: Russian troops attacked a civilian cargo ship flying the Liberian flag in one of the ports of the Odesa region; one crew member was killed and three were wounded.

item.title: IAEA reports damage to transformers near Zaporizhzhia NPP, seeks truce for repairs
item.description: The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) has reported a series of drone attacks in recent weeks that have further heightened the threat to nuclear safety and security at the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant (ZNPP).
